subject: Portal SSO proofing & owner-of-record transition — staging to production
messages:
From: Elena Martinez <elena@brightleaf.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightLeaf IT <it@brightleaf.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: SSO proof + owner-of-record transfer for Vendor profile

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week — excited to move BrightLeaf's profile from the staging workspace into our production vendor portal so we can complete procurement. Before we flip the switch, our security team needs a couple of things from Redwood:

- SAML metadata and test assertion logs showing a successful bind to your production SSO endpoint (we can accept redacted timestamps)
- A signed attestation that the profile owner-of-record is changing from "RL Staging Team" to "BrightLeaf Security" (we usually collect a DocuSign for this)
- A small CAIQ fragment (controls we rely on for connectivity) confirming how session cookies are scoped for third-party embeds

I've attached a ZIP with our expected schema and a sample DocuSign template. Can you confirm who on your side will own the transfer and an ETA? We are hoping to complete procurement by Dec 3.

Thanks,
Elena
Director, Security Operations
BrightLeaf

Attachments: brightleaf_sso_requirements_template.zip (zip), sample-docusign-template.pdf (pdf)
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@brightleaf.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SSO proof + owner-of-record transfer for Vendor profile

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear checklist and timeline.

Short answer: I will coordinate the transfer and own the profile handoff. Plan below and quick asks for you so we don't block procurement.

Planned steps (Redwood):
- Tue/Wed: Generate production SAML metadata and run a test assertion against BrightLeaf test SP; collect assertion logs and redact PII.
- Thu: Upload artifacts to Vendr profile and send DocuSign owner-transfer to the BrightLeaf Sig Admin.
- Fri: Confirm profile state change to production and share final CAIQ fragment.

Immediate asks for BrightLeaf:
1) Please confirm the BrightLeaf signer email for DocuSign (the person who will sign the owner-of-record change).
2) If you prefer the upload through the Vendr API vs. sending us the DocuSign first, say so — we can do either.

Notes:
- Jonas will pull the SAML logs and redact timestamps; Marissa will stage the CAIQ fragment for the profile.
- Kimberly, looping you for SSO presign instructions and whether we should use our ephemeral upload flow or attach artifacts directly in Vendr.

Elena — can you confirm signer and whether to use Vendr upload? If you confirm today we should meet your Dec 3 procurement date.

Best,
Olga
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference

Hi Olga — thanks for the plan.

Signer for DocuSign: Ilya Rachman (ila.rachman@brightleaf.com) — he'll sign the owner transfer.
Vendr upload: we prefer you to upload artifacts directly into the Vendr profile (the org sheet needs the evidence links). If you have trouble with the API, send the ZIP via our SFTP (creds in the attached template).

We've attached the CAIQ fragment we expect (controls 1.2, 3.4, 7.1 are most important to us). Also included SAML test harness instructions — follow step 2b for test assertion capture.

We are good to sign as soon as DocuSign arrives.

Elena

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Ilya Rachman <ila.rachman@brightleaf.com>, Elena Martinez <elena@brightleaf.com>

Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SSO proof + owner-of-record transfer for Vendor profile

Hi Ilya / Elena — looping in the rest of the team with an ETA and artifact links.

Status update: 
- SAML metadata (production) attached and uploaded to Vendr at: https://app.vendr.com/orgs/brightleaf/profiles/12345/artifacts/67890
- Test assertion logs: pulled, redacted, and included in the ZIP attached to this thread (brightleaf_sso_artifacts.zip)
- CAIQ fragment: Marissa prepared the fragment and it's attached (brightleaf_caiaq_fragment.pdf)
- DocuSign: sent to Ilya this morning for the owner-of-record change; please sign when convenient. DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/brightleaf/sso-attestation-nd

Upload notes for BrightLeaf IT (Kimberly, cc'd):
- We used Vendr's API ephemeral-upload endpoint to avoid presigned S3 exposure. If you need S3 presigns instead, we can provide them but will require a short security change window.
- File list uploaded: brightleaf_saml_metadata.xml, assertion_logs_20261126_redacted.txt, brightleaf_caiaq_fragment.pdf

Next steps:
1) Ilya signs DocuSign (triggers vendor portal ownership state change).
2) BrightLeaf confirms receipt of artifacts in Vendr and that procurement can proceed.
3) Redwood will mark the profile production and record the transfer in our internal ownership ledger (link: https://na1.redwood-inference.com/internal/ownership-transfer/BR-7890).

If there are any gaps in the CAIQ fragment or you need additional timestamped logs, Jonas can pull a follow-up trace (we kept the original telemetry) — let us know.

Thanks — glad we could close this quickly.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference
